title: MD Agro Engineering
description: A modern industrial website for a rural agricultural and steel fabrication workshop showcasing tractor attachments, fabrication projects, portable cabins, and custom engineering works. Built with a simple mobile-first experience focused on trust, WhatsApp communication, project visibility, and scalable frontend architecture for future Firebase-powered management features.

title: TypeFromImage
description: Typing practice platform that lets users train with custom text and image-based content. Built as a prototype-first product with real-time input handling and audio feedback to improve engagement and validate the idea early.

title: Habiqua Room Rental System
description: SaaS-style room rental system designed around listing, booking, and pricing workflows. Focused on practical product structure, role handling, and maintainable system design.

title: S3 Library Platform
description: Multi-tenant SaaS platform built to solve real library management issues. Included subscriptions, seat allocation, admin workflows, and product validation through direct library feedback.

title: Real-Time Chat + Multiplayer System
description: Real-time application with chat and multiplayer game features. Built around event-driven architecture, live communication, and synchronized state across users.

title: Expense Tracker Web App
description: Expense tracking system with CRUD operations, reporting, and MySQL integration. Built to manage budgets and understand practical data-driven workflows.

title: Sudoku Solver
description: Recursive backtracking-based Sudoku solver focused on constraint checking, search optimization, and algorithmic problem solving.

title: N-Queens Solver
description: Backtracking solution for the N-Queens problem built to improve understanding of recursion, constraint handling, and algorithm design.

title: Rat in a Maze Solver
description: Pathfinding project using recursion and constraint validation. Built to strengthen logical thinking, boundary handling, and algorithmic structure.

title: Mars Mission Graphics Program
description: C-based graphics simulation created to explore rendering logic, trajectory visualization, and early computer graphics concepts.
